title: Not Enough Emerald Tools &  Armor
description: A simple mod that add Emerald Tools & Armor
body:
![COPERTINA](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/59f5a4276f0e59fc6e4e8bd3cbbef1cb01ec6278_0.webp)
Emerald Tools & Armor – Simple, Powerful, Heroic (v1.0)

Bring the elegance and power of emerald to your Minecraft world with Emerald Tools & Armor, a lightweight and easy-to-use mod!

Fully functional emerald tools: sword, pickaxe, axe, shovel, and hoe, each crafted to perfection.

Stylish emerald armor: helmet, chestplate, leggings, and boots with custom textures and layers.

Full set bonus – Hero of the Village: wear all four pieces of emerald armor to gain the Hero of the Village effect! Remove even one piece, and the effect disappears – simple, balanced, and intuitive.

Easy to craft and play: no complicated mechanics, just pure Minecraft fun.

This is the first version (v1.0) of the mod! Your feedback, suggestions, and ideas are greatly appreciated to help improve future updates.

Perfect for players who love polished, minimalist mods that enhance gameplay without overcomplicating it. Suit up, become a hero, and let your emerald shine!
